noncanonicalGrants.description: Same claims as minimal-saas with reversed JSON key order, re-signed with valid k1 key. Must be rejected for canonicality, not signature.

daemonOfferDigestVectors.description: SHA-256 of the complete length-prefixed signed FCDO envelope

resignedVectors.description: minimal-saas payload re-signed with the high-S counterpart (r, n-s). Valid ECDSA, canonical JCS, but rejected by the low-S rule in both languages.
attachmentCapabilities carries ordinal 255 (outside the closed 1..=13 vocabulary). Rejected at claim decoding in both languages.
attachmentCapabilities [1,1] duplicates an ordinal. Rejected by the ceiling encoder's strictly-ascending rule in both languages.
attachmentCapabilities [3,1] is not strictly ascending. Rejected by the ceiling encoder in both languages.
serviceVersion '01' (leading zero) parses to 1 and the grant is ACCEPTED in both languages, matching Rust parse_decimal_u64 which accepts any all-digit u64.
